Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 select contract_id, company
 into :contract_id, :company
 from contracts
 where contract_id = :contract_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and contract_type = 'IM'
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dummy number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select batch_id, product_type,number_of_units
 into :batch_id, :product_type,:entered_count
 from batch_inputs
 where contract_id = :contract_id and
 received_date =:received_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 batch_id = :batch_id
 and batch_id in (select batch_id from units
 where contract_id = :contract_id
 and received_date = :received_date
 and nvl(qc_checkin_flag,'N') != 'Y'
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
 select /*count(*),*/count(decode(qc_checkin_flag,null,1,null)) -- Removed "count(*)" and placed it in below query
 into /*:actual_count,*/dummy -- Commented by Kishore on 02/18/2011. IM 4778
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and contract_id = :contract_id
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 if dummy = 0
 then
 show_error('6071');
 end if;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 02/18/2011. IM 4778
 select count(*)
 into :actual_count
 from units u, components c
 where u.batch_id = :batch_id
 and u.contract_id = :contract_id
 and trunc(u.received_date) = trunc(:received_date)
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and u.unit_id = c.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = c.chapter_id;
 -- End of change
--
 if :entered_count != :actual_count
 then
 GO_ITEM('ack');
 else
 do_query;
 end if;
--
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.last_record != 'TRUE'
 then
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag is null
 then
 :qc_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :qc_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 update units
 set qc_checkin_flag = :qc_checkin_flag,
 qc_checkin_date = sysdate,
 qc_label_flag = 'Y',
 qc_label_date = sysdate
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units table');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 update batch_inputs
 set qc_date = sysdate
 where contract_id = :contract_id and
 batch_id = :batch_id and
 qc_date is null and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 trunc(received_date) = trunc(:received_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating batch inputs table');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

is
